name: Ruler
description: Represents the ruler for the text in the specified shape or for all text in the specified text style. Contains tab stops and the indentation settings for text outline levels.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object.

properties.name: TabStops
properties.description: Returns a TabStops collection that represents the tab stops for the specified text. Read-only.

properties.name: Levels
properties.description: Returns a RulerLevels object that represents outline indent formatting. Read-only.
